requirements.text: Personalised timetable management should allow students to customize views with color-coding and hide canceled classes.
Personalised timetable management should include easy syncing to personal calendar apps.
Grade notifications should be sent out within a few minutes of grades being posted.
Grade notifications should have delivery options like email or in-app alerts based on student preferences.
The module feedback system should provide a straightforward way for students to give feedback on content quality and delivery after the teaching period.
The module feedback system should have a structured approach that considers timing and anonymity.
All enhancements should integrate well with the existing portal infrastructure to avoid disruptions.
Ensure that the overall functionality is enhanced without negatively impacting the current user experience.
